metadata.title: Clicked like I sneezed and somehow got a kill? Valorant’s drunk again!
metadata.description:
Me: just trying to survive
Enemy: probably uninstalling mid-shock
Valorant said ‘Here’s a kill, don’t ask why’
Click if your aim’s pure chaos too!

Tap if your best kills come from pure panic!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
